name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's journey into motorsport finance began unconventionally, with a degree in economics and an early career in auditing. His passion for racing ignited during a family trip to the Estoril circuit, sparking a desire to merge his financial expertise with the adrenaline of the track. After several years in corporate finance, Ricardo transitioned to motorsports, taking on roles of increasing responsibility within various teams. His meticulous approach to budget management and strategic financial planning quickly earned him a reputation for fiscal responsibility and creative problem-solving.

Ricardo's distinctive trait is his ability to identify and mitigate financial risks while simultaneously exploring innovative funding opportunities. He believes in empowering teams through transparent financial reporting and fostering a culture of fiscal awareness. His experience at Hitech Development has been marked by his commitment to sustainable growth and his knack for securing crucial sponsorships that fuel the team's competitive edge. He's a firm believer that a well-managed budget is as crucial to winning as a powerful engine.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly stocky build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'The Intelligent Investor' by Benjamin Graham.
Insists on starting team meetings with a brief economic forecast.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
